The '''Imperial Weapon Research Facility''', also known as the '''Weapon Development Facility''', was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] research facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:WDF" />

==History==
{{Quote|Okay, it's a ways out there. I'll show you on your datapad. Watch out, though. The Empire doesn't want their little secrets getting out, but we'll all know one day. I'm telling you, the truth is out there. Go see it for yourself and you'll believe!|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ac">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|a commoner|Naboo}}</ref>}}
The Imperial Weapon Research Facility was built by the Empire soon after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:VS" /> It was a top secret and restricted area.<ref name="SWG:ac" /> It was defended by a garrison of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and several [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]].<ref name="SWG:WDF" /> A commoner from [[Kaadara]] once discovered the Facility while getting lost during a trip from [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] to [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]].<ref name="SWG:ac" /> The [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Roric V`lia]] and his employee [[Vaik'anna Silverlight]] had activities related to the Facility.<ref name="SWG:VS" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the Weapon Development Facility had become a contested hotspot in the Galactic Civil War and Imperial and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces fought several times for the control of the facility. Rebel forces managed to capture the facility several times but Imperial forces had always taken it back.<ref name="StW" />

The [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] equipped on the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Conqueror (superlaser)|''Conqueror'']] was developed at the research facility. Located in the facility were testing bays and fabrication chambers, along with a main control room with [[Computer/Legends|computer]] consoles containing data on the Star Destroyer. It was guarded by the [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] [[Namman Cha]] at the time.<ref name="TotC">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref> In 1 ABY,<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> it was [[Mission to Naboo (Renegade Squadron)|raided]] by the Rebel Alliance's [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]], who defeated Cha and gained sensitive information on the ''Conqueror'', which they were later able to use to locate and [[Mission to Mustafar (Renegade Squadron)|destroy]] the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]].<ref name="TotC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Weapon Research Facility appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:WDF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update on [[August 3]], 2003,<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref> the Imperial Weapon Research Facility was turned into a "Factional NPC Base". Groups of Rebel players could attack Imperial NPCs and achieve several objectives to take control of the base.<ref name="StW" />
